subject: Architectural workshop: Hosted API integration (SDKs, streaming, tool-calling) — scheduling
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@medzen.health>, Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@medzen.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:07:00 -0000
Subject: Architectural workshop: Hosted API integration (SDKs, streaming, tool-calling) — scheduling

Hi Tom / Marta —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we recommend a 90-minute architectural workshop to walk through how MedZen's ingestion pipeline and UI will integrate with Redwood's Hosted API. We'll cover SDK options, streaming vs non-streaming, KV cache behavior for conversational flows, and function/tool-calling patterns for your lab-results ingestion.

Proposed time slots (US/Eastern):
- Tue Mar 23, 10:00–11:30 AM ET
- Wed Mar 24, 2:00–3:30 PM ET
- Thu Mar 25, 11:00–12:30 PM ET

Attendees from our side: Jonas (platform/integration), Marissa (solutions/SDKs), Olga (security/ops). Could you confirm the right MedZen attendees (product, infra, and a dev who will own the integration)? If none of the times work, suggest 2–3 alternatives and your timezone.

Draft agenda attached (short, focused): design overview, SDK choices, streaming tradeoffs, tool-calling patterns, rollout/observability checklist, next steps.

Attachment: MedZen_Integration_Workshop_Agenda.pdf (3 pages)

If helpful I can send a calendar hold once we lock a time.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — Production-grade inference for engineers
From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@medzen.health>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 14:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Architectural workshop: Hosted API integration (SDKs, streaming, tool-calling) — scheduling

Jonas —

Thanks for the agenda. Marta and I reviewed it and this is exactly the level of detail we want. We have two key asks up front:
1) Can you cover implications of streaming on our existing websocket-based UI? We need to understand connection lifecycle and partial-output handling.
2) We will want a short run-through of function/tool calling for automated lab tagging and for triggering downstream jobs — a code snippet would be great.

On timing: Wed Mar 24 at 2:00 PM ET works best for Product + one eng (I will invite Sergio from infra if available). Could we shorten to 75 minutes to accommodate an internal standup? If not possible, we can keep 90. Timezone note: Sergio is in Mountain Time (MT) — he might ask to move earlier.

Also, can you record the session? We will share with our security reviewer but would rather not circulate slides until after a brief redaction pass.

Tom
Director of Product
MedZen Health
tom.reed@medzen.health | +1 (646) 555-2144

Subject: Re: Architectural workshop: Hosted API integration (SDKs, streaming, tool-calling) — scheduling

Tom —

75 minutes is doable — we'll tighten the agenda and prioritize streaming + tool-calling. Proposed updated agenda will be 5 min intros, 25 min SDK & streaming (patterns + demo), 20 min function/tool-calling walkthrough (code + sandbox), 15 min rollout/observability checklist, 10 min Q&A/next steps.

Jonas, can you carve out the demo so we show a short streaming example (partial outputs + reconnect) and a small function-calling snippet? I can prepare a condensed slide pack and a sandbox repo link for the attendees.

Olga — please confirm if we should pre-send any security artifacts (SOC2 excerpt, network diagram) to speed up MedZen's internal review.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Tom / Marta —

Great — Wed Mar 24, 2:00–3:15 PM ET (75 minutes) is locked. I've updated the agenda to the condensed version Marissa proposed and attached the PDF. We will record the session; recording will be stored in Redwood's internal workspace and we will share a link with you (can restrict access if you need to redact).

Calendar event (Google Calendar): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=medzen-workshop-20260324
HubSpot meeting: https://hubspot.app/mod/engagements/records/MDZ-3211

Attachments: medzen_workshop_invite.ics (calendar hold), MedZen_Integration_Workshop_Agenda.pdf

Agenda highlights:
- SDKs & streaming (Marissa) — demo of partial-output handling, reconnection strategy, and client-side queueing.
- Function/tool-calling patterns (Jonas) — sample server-side handler + security posture for callback URLs.
- Rollout & observability (Olga) — tracing, token-level cost breakdown, and fallback model policies.

Requested MedZen attendees: Tom (Product), Marta (Product), Sergio (Infra) — if Sergio can't make the full session we'll record and set a 20-minute follow-up to cover infra questions.

If anything changes I'll send an updated hold. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Jonas Weber
